notes.title: [Game Version 0.5.6] Lunar New Year Update
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year to all players!
At the same time, the Spring Festival discount will also be opened at the same time!

Updates:
1.Added [Holiday related content], Unlock the special item formula during Spring Festival [Red Envelope].
2.Added [Holiday related content], Unlock the special item formula during Spring Festival [Firecracker].
3.Added [Holiday related content], Unlock the special decoration formula during Spring Festival [Spring Festival Couplets)].
4.Added [Holiday related content], Unlock the special decoration formula during Spring Festival [Fu].
5.Added [Emergency Food], and its formula.
6.Added [Bandage], and its formula.
7.Added [Large Piece of Steak].
8.Added [Grilled Steak], and its formula.
9.Added [Mutatted Steak], and its formula.
10.Added [Fruit].
11.Added [Fruit Jam], and its formula.
12.Added [Fruit Jam Bread], and its formula.
13.Added Placemark [Ornate Tent].
14.Added [Knockback] effect to the enemies, which can vary depending on the weapon type used by the player.
15.Added the Map Level of islands, and the enemy difficulty varies with the map level.
16.Added the [Adventurer Level] system, which will affect the player's [Available Formula], and the player can check his level through [Adventurer Medal].
17.Modified the effects when hit enemies.
18.Fixed a BUG when quickly tapping the map to open the backpack would cause it to open again.

The game is still in the EA stage, please feel free to share your suggestions!
Use steam community or Email: dk0179@3dmgame.com

notes.title: [Game Version 0.5.5] Christmas Update
notes.content:
Merry Christmas to all players!
In this update, there will also be a variety of holiday items, and I hope you can also experience the spirit of Christmas in the game!

Updates:
1. Added [Holiday related content], all red wood and yellow wood trees will be converted to Christmas trees on Christmas Day.
2. Added [Holiday related content], unlock the special box formula on Christmas Day [Gift box].
3. Added [Holiday related content], unlock the special weapon formula on Christmas Day [Candy cane].
4. Added [Magnificent treasure box], [Magnificent treasure box]’s storage capacity is the same as ordinary treasure box, but it is more beautiful!
5. Added new Placeable item [Saving pot], a [Saving pot] can store 1,000 gold coins per interaction. When you break the saving pot, all gold coins will be returned. The storage space of all saving pots are interlinked.
6. Added the interact range of placeable items, now you can interact with a placeable item to open its interface by pressing the space bar.
7. Added more space to your ship, now you can place items or decorations on your ship.
8. Added player [zimo]’s weapon as a hidden reward, you can try to find it out!
9. Modified the ship image, it is now a whole ship instead of just one bow!
10. Modified the image of some scene decorations.
11. Modified the image of all [Ores], you can now better distinguish them.
12. Modified the save and load function in commission: Cooking in the restaurant] and [Dream Instance]. Now you can no longer save or load in the middle of the commission.
13. Modified the image size of all weapons when performing attacks, which enlarged the image of the weapons but didn’t change their attack range.
14. Modified the default displays of the formula table, it is now displays all formulas instead of showing only formulas that meet the compositing criteria.

The game is still in the EA stage, please feel free to share your suggestions!
Use steam community or Email: dk0179@3dmgame.com

notes.title: Game content adjustment, patch update
notes.content:
We’ve got a lot of feedback from players since entering EA testing!
So here’s some quick updates and fixes:

1.	Increased player’s movement speed
2.	Added a hint that shows the ship is critically damaged
3.	Decreased the durability reduction rate of ships while sailing
4.	Rabbits and chickens no longer run away
5.	Increased the initial attack power from 10→15
6.	Increased the attack speed of players and some weapons
7.	The range around the backpack of discarded items is now set
8.	Decreased the stats of all enemies
9.	Increased the bullet speed of some long-range weapons
10.	Full screen operations are now recorded
11.	Adjusted the interactable touch points
12.	Added enemies’ health bars
13.	Added explanatory text for icons on the right side
14.	Added new story at the beginning of the game [Open your backpack near the chest to view]

If you have more suggestions about our game, you can simply leave a post in the Steam community page, or join our Discord, or send us an email at: dk0179@3dmgame.com

Thank you for your support!
